name: Mento South African Rand
oneLiner: Mento's reserve-backed South African rand stablecoin on Celo: oracle-priced USDm/ZARm Broker pool issues and retires under legacy V2; governance winding down.
collateral: Shared Mento Reserve: ZARm is reserve-backed rather than CDP-backed. Its backing is the protocol's diversified, dynamically managed reserve (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH and smaller positions via the Mento reserve dashboard), not USDm locked in a ZARm-specific trove.
pegMechanism: ZARm is issued and retired through Mento V2's oracle-priced USDm/ZARm Broker/BiPoolManager constant-sum pool: a USDm-to-ZARm swap burns incoming USDm and mints outgoing ZARm, and the reverse burns ZARm, priced off the ZAR/USD oracle with spread, trading-limit, freshness and BreakerBox checks; Mento governance (MGP-18) is winding down V2 with per-token trading limits capped at outstanding supply plus 10%.
